title: IS LOCAL SEO
*WORTH IT*
FOR YOU?
slides.sub: Five checks to run before you spend a cent on it.

title: “WILL SEO WORK
*FOR MY BUSINESS?”*
slides.body: Almost every Perth owner asks me this first. Five quick checks give you the answer.

title: PEOPLE SEARCH
*FOR WHAT YOU DO*
slides.body: Type your trade and suburb into Google, like “electrician Midland”. If Google finishes the phrase for you, people are searching for it.

title: YOUR CUSTOMERS
*LIVE NEARBY*
slides.body: You work a set of suburbs, from a shopfront or from the ute. Local SEO puts you in front of people in those suburbs.

title: COMPETITORS
*ARE ON THE MAP*
slides.body: Search “dentist Subiaco” and three dentists show on the map. Good news: customers are searching (and right now they're calling someone else).

title: YOU HAVE ROOM
*FOR MORE JOBS*
slides.body: Booked out until March? Then more calls only make people wait.

title: YOU'LL STICK
*WITH IT FOR MONTHS*
slides.body: Local SEO is slow. Your profile, reviews and website get stronger every month. Quit after six weeks and you paid for the slow part only.

title: *RECAP*
items: People Google your trade and suburb
Competitors already show on the map
You have room for more jobs
You'll stick with it for months

title: WANT A
*FREE AUDIT?*
slides.body: Send us a DM and I'll check your Google profile for free.
